name: supervise-indicator
description: Supervise Indicator - UPS status for the GNOME Shell. The type=module exists only so Node can import logReader.js in the tests; GNOME Shell ignores this file.

scripts.translations: for lang in $(cat po/LINGUAS); do mkdir -p locale/$lang/LC_MESSAGES && msgfmt --check -o locale/$lang/LC_MESSAGES/supervise-indicator.mo po/$lang.po; done
scripts.release: npm run pot && npm run translations && npm run pack
